name: design-token-adoption
description: Staged retrofit playbook for adopting a design token architecture in an existing (brownfield) UI built from raw hex/px/rgba literals. Walks a project through a no-UI-change foundation stage (token SSOT + framework bridge + honest lint config), per-layer codemod stages (type scale, then color with near-duplicate collapse under a computed WCAG contrast proof, then radii/shadows/layout), and a machine-verified allowlist-residue sweep until the design lint passes with documented residue only. Use when: adopting design tokens in an existing UI, running a token retrofit, planning a staged token-migration PR series, or reducing a design-lint allowlist. Greenfield projects follow design-foundation Stage 4 instead; raw-value detection alone is token-usage-lint.
